Maya (acct exec): Heads-up: Aegis Financial escalated to their COO. POC paused — they require a short exec call to confirm BYOK, KMS rotation guarantees, and an explicit statement about no-model-shard egress. They want the call tomorrow morning. Can we prep a 3-slide pack and a one-liner for the COO? @Diego @Ravi :urgent:
Diego (security): Noted. Primary asks: 1) BYOK acceptance + attestation, 2) rotation semantics (how quickly can keys be rotated and enforced), 3) audit trail for decrypt ops. We can provide an attestation doc and audit sample but need eng to confirm rotation behavior.
Ravi (eng-runtime): Short answers: we accept wrapped customer KEKs, store wrapped DEKs only; rotation is supported via our KMS-proxy endpoint, effective within ~30s for new tokens after cache invalidation. No key material is exported plaintext. I'll write a 2-line technical note for the slide.
Claire (prod): For the exec slide: a one-liner decision tree (Hosted+BYOK = fast, routed EU-only but soft failover; Dedicated = contractual EU residency + SLA; Private = full isolation). Keep it simple. I'll assemble slides once we have the one-liners.
Tess (legal): I'll prepare a short POC addendum: BYOK custody language + audit retention options (30/90/365). Also will propose a limited POC credit if SLA is breached. Need eng to confirm rotation timing claim for contract language.
ticket-bot: runbook created: /runbooks/aegis-poc-exec-escalation-1787654321  owners: @Ravi @Diego @Tess
Diego (security): Also ask: can we provide a sanitized sample audit log for decrypt ops? That tends to reassure COOs.
Ravi (eng-runtime): Yes, I can generate a redacted sample showing timestamp, request id, region, and key-hash. No plaintext keys. Will drop in runbook in 45m.
Maya (acct exec): Timeline: slides + one-liner by EOD today, addendum draft for legal review in 2hrs, sample audit log + tech note in 1hr. I'll schedule the exec call once deck is in.
Claire (prod): Assign owners: Ravi (tech note + sample log), Diego (security slide bullets + attestation), Tess (POC addendum), Claire (assemble deck).
Tess (legal): Acknowledged — I'll ping when draft is uploaded.
Maya (acct exec): Thanks team. Please ping here when assets are uploaded. :pray:
